title: Default agent + DFO
caveat: Full 92-problem research archive; 61/276 native attempts have provider, time-limit or invalid-start anomalies. Achieved histories are retained. Not a new Harbor ranking.
reference_policy: Selected solvers only, including the canonical initial objective; per problem and repetition; run_plain=False
repetition_policy: First 3 archived repetitions, fixed before solver selection; no best-repeat selection
alignment_policy: Declared feature distribution/seed schedule and problem dimension agree; initial clean objectives agree at rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-14. Realized x0 is not reconstructed from objective values.
baseline_policy: Combined scope uses GPT archive baseline columns once. Other baseline revisions remain in their original scopes.
partial_history_policy: All recorded attempts retained, including interrupted/early-ended runs; no completion-conditioned filtering
